sections.content_text: Section 270 - Penalty for Disobedience to Notice Where any person, without reasonable cause, disobeys any notice issued under section 167, 168, 179, 181 or 183, the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes may impose on such person such penalty not exceeding the amount of tax chargeable on his total income.
